title: Coordinate restriction of a sign function
statement: Given a Boolean function $f$ on $n$ coordinates and a coordinate restriction $ho$ that either leaves each coordinate free or fixes it to $1$ or $-1$, the restricted function sends an input $x$ to the value of $f$ at the completion of $x$ specified by $ho$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on n coordinates
coordinate restriction assigning each coordinate free, fixed to 1, or fixed to -1
